answer: Trust is federated into islands, and weight crosses an island boundary only when an identity on one island has been endorsed by an identity on another that has no shared path back, so a farm confined to one island cannot export its internal reputation outward. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The horizon is the island, the basalt the endorsement that crosses it, and the gale the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one horizon is cheap to hold, but a basalt only counts when no gale exists, and that takes independent history.
